'''Pig tails''' are an [[underground]] [[crop]]. They can be [[farming|grown]] only in summer and autumn. They may be [[plant processing|processed]] at a [[farmer's workshop]] to create [[thread|pig tail thread]], which is then used to [[weaving|weave]] [[cloth|pig tail cloth]] at a [[loom]]. 
Otherwise, they may be [[brewing|brewed]] into [[Dwarven ale]].
Not to be confused with tails of [[pig|actual pigs]].

With [[Harder Farming]] turned on pig tails will take one year to grow to maturity. Without it they will take about one season.
